item.title: Capturing the 'primal energy of Wolverine' in a new look, Sony is going all-in on Marvel’s Wolverine with a new PS5 collection that includes covers, a DualSense, and a limited-edition console
item.description: Sony is giving Marvel’s Wolverine the full PlayStation treatment with a new collection of Battle Yellow and Adamantium PS5 hardware, including console covers for PS5 and PS5 Pro, DualSense controllers, and a limited-edition PS5 console.
